name: silver_spine
description: Hospital-window spine: fill sources, populations and window bands

kwargs.unexpected_rows_query: SELECT * FROM {batch} WHERE (county_fips IS NULL) <> (county_source IS NULL)
SELECT * FROM {batch} WHERE (state_code IS NULL) <> (state_source IS NULL)
SELECT * FROM {batch} WHERE provider_subtype_code IS NOT NULL AND classification_source IS NULL
SELECT * FROM {batch} WHERE planning_region_fips IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_connecticut
SELECT * FROM {batch} WHERE is_primary_population AND NOT is_sensitivity_population
SELECT window_year FROM {batch} GROUP BY window_year HAVING count(*) < <<spine.windows_per_year.min>> OR count(*) > <<spine.windows_per_year.max>>
SELECT 1 FROM {batch} HAVING avg(CASE WHEN county_fips IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) < <<spine.county_share.min>>
